DroidAlly.Title: Droid Ally Pricing
DroidAlly.Subtitle: Companion Cost Estimator
DroidAlly.GmGuidance: GM-only tool. This estimates a purchase price for a droid ally using SW5E companion assumptions; it does not bypass prerequisites, one-companion limits, or GM approval.
DroidAlly.ResultDisclaimer: Optional SW5E-adapted estimate. The GM decides availability, legality, condition, and whether the droid is equipment, a helper NPC, or a full companion.
DroidAlly.ChatPosted: Droid ally price quote posted to chat.
DroidAlly.ChatNoResult: Calculate a droid price before sharing it to chat.

Help.Name: Optional. Enter the droid's name or model designation for the quote.
Help.Class: Choose the closest SW5E droid role or chassis category. This sets the base chassis value.
Help.Level: For a full companion, enter the companion level. For a helper NPC, enter a CR-style value the GM feels matches its stat block.
Help.Systems: Enter the credit value of installed systems, gear, weapons, tools, armor, or a factory package.
Help.Abilities: Add the droid's final ability modifiers together. Negative totals are allowed, but only positive value increases price.
Help.Traits: Count notable droid traits, protocols, special actions, or built-in features that matter in play.
Help.Proficiencies: Count trained skills and tool proficiencies the droid can meaningfully use.
Help.Feats: Count feats, major upgrades, premium modifications, or equivalent enhancements.

ClassHelp.ClassI: Scientific, medical, analysis, mathematics, and research droids.
ClassHelp.ClassII: Astromech, engineering, exploration, environmental, and maintenance droids.
ClassHelp.ClassIII: Protocol, etiquette, translation, tutoring, service, and social droids.
ClassHelp.ClassIV: Military, assassin, gladiator, bodyguard, and security droids.
ClassHelp.ClassV: Labor, mining, hauling, sanitation, construction, and transportation droids.
ClassHelp.Tracker: A specialized SW5E tracker droid companion, commonly tied to tech-focused characters.
ClassHelp.Custom: Use this when pricing an unusual droid that does not map cleanly to Class I-V.

Warning.MissingSw5e: SW5E companion content was not detected as active. The module can still load, but SW5E-specific integrations may be unavailable.
Warning.UnexpectedSystem: This module is designed for the dnd5e system. Current system compatibility should be reviewed before use.
Warning.IncompleteEnvironment: The runtime environment appears incomplete. Some integrations may be unavailable.
Warning.PlanetDataLoadFailed: Planet data could not be loaded. The local dataset is unavailable, so origin and destination selection has been disabled.

CalculationMode.Name: Calculation Mode
CalculationMode.Hint: Choose the default hyperspace calculation model.

EnableRandomEvents.Name: Enable Random Events
EnableRandomEvents.Hint: Allow travel calculations to optionally include random hyperspace events.

RandomEventChance.Name: Random Event Chance
RandomEventChance.Hint: Percentage chance that a random event occurs during a trip.

FuelPerHour.Name: Fuel Per Hour
FuelPerHour.Hint: Default fuel consumed per hour of travel.

FoodPerCrewPerDay.Name: Food Per Crew Per Day
FoodPerCrewPerDay.Hint: Default food consumed by each crew member per day.

DebugMode.Name: Debug Logging
DebugMode.Hint: Enable additional debug logging for this client.

PilotingFallbackSkill.Name: Piloting fallback skill
PilotingFallbackSkill.Hint: If pil / piloting are missing on the pilot actor, rolls use this skill id (e.g. acr). SW5E also tries tec before failing.

AdvancedMaxTier.Name: Advanced mode - maximum hyperspace tier
AdvancedMaxTier.Hint: Lanes above this tier are excluded from pathfinding except segments marked essential for connectivity (transit corridors, regional connectors). 1 = broadest major routes, 5 = narrowest.

AdvancedIncludeObscureRoutes.Name: Advanced mode - include obscure routes
AdvancedIncludeObscureRoutes.Hint: When enabled, lanes marked obscure (e.g. regional connectors, back routes) can appear in pathfinding.

AdvancedTier5ExtraDc.Name: Advanced mode - extra DC per tier-5 hop
AdvancedTier5ExtraDc.Hint: Added to the piloting DC once for each hop that uses a tier-5 lane, on top of any per-lane DC bonus in the data. Use 0 to rely on data only.
